title: Head of Credit / Credit Manager
cardBlurb: Build the credit engine of a new-generation, AI-native NBFC, from the first policy to the first disbursement.
description:
Pfundit is building a technology-first NBFC, and we’re looking for our first senior credit leader. You will write the credit policy, set the underwriting standards for Assigned Future Receivables and Loan Against Property, and work with our technology team to turn sound credit judgement into a data-driven decision engine. If you want to design credit the right way and see it operate at scale, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Write and establish foundational credit policy and risk framework from day zero.
  • Set rigorous underwriting standards for Assigned Future Receivables and Loan Against Property (LAP).
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to turn credit judgement into data-driven decision rules.
  • Oversee loan structuring, portfolio monitoring, and early warning indicators.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Credit – Head / Manager”.

title: Head – Business Development, Sales & Partnerships
cardBlurb: Build the growth engine of a new-generation, AI-native NBFC: its channels, its partners and its market.
description:
Pfundit is building a technology-first NBFC, and we’re looking for the leader who will take it to market. You will design our distribution from scratch, building channel and partner networks for Loan Against Property, originating Assigned Future Receivables programmes, and creating digital partnerships that put our products where customers already are. Growth here is built on trust, compliance and portfolio quality. If you have built distribution for a lender before, and want to build it again the right way, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Design and scale commercial distribution and origination channels across India.
  • Build channel partner networks and sourcing ecosystems for Loan Against Property.
  • Originate bespoke Assigned Future Receivables lending programmes for high-growth enterprises.
  • Create digital partnerships that embed Pfundit credit solutions directly into enterprise workflows.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Business Development, Sales & Partnerships – Head”.
